title: ML Studio 2026.11.18.2
notes:
- Set independent track and clip color strengths in the Theme Editor, including flat exact colors for the Traditional and Full Mixer, Playlist headers and clip bodies, and Channel Rack names.
- Keep the right-side Mixer inspector title clear of the size dropdown and window buttons in Full Mixer and Channel Strip views.
- Keep same-name audio and Playlist exports with automatic numbering, or confirm replacements. Multi-format renders and stems share the same number.
- Edit text normally in project name and path fields, Browser and Plugin Picker search, and other built-in fields, with visible carets, selection, clipboard shortcuts and Space.
- Use the new hover-to-open Browser categories, collections and recent items, with a per-profile option to restore the legacy Browser.
- Resize the Tune Vocals editor in the Playlist or double-click its grip to expand and restore it.
- Fix the first playback and cold export of tuned vocals after reopening a project or changing tempo.
- Save a user template as the default for startup and File > New, and use Empty (no tracks) to start with zero Playlist lanes and Mixer inserts.
- Add ML Pure Player, a SoundFont instrument with an optional General MIDI library, and ML Riser, a stock build-up effect.
